title: Some of the places we've been
card_message:
I wanted to put together an album of many of our most recent memories (with some older included as well). I thought you probably didnt have many of these and thought it would be fun to see them on a map of some of the places we have been together.

We have made so many great memories in the past years and it has been such a privilege to work with you towards a common mission in the last couple.

I look forward to continuing to fill this map up with more memories!
